subsystems.finding: A Python ctypes facade owns one process-global native engine, performs fail-fast resident-weight identity checks, executes at most eight returned calls, and downloads the platform library from Hugging Face without a pinned digest.
Callable annotations, literals, enums, defaults, docstrings, and Pydantic models compile to schemas; union handling collapses to the first member.
Six device-action domains share positive, missing-detail, irrelevant-tool, negation, invalid-input, and parallel-call cases; pass requires at least 90 percent plus zero critical failures.
Bounded concurrent teacher generation is deduplicated; the training target shares the tool-call rendering shape and masks prompt tokens; LoRA factors stay fp32 and zero groups are skipped.

The visible model uses lexical Engram memory, mHC residual routing, gated grouped-query attention, and Walsh-Hadamard MLP transforms; cached-decoder parity and document-prefix sinks lack tests, and the prefix helper currently returns zero.
CQ uses Walsh-Hadamard groups, Lloyd-Max codebooks, fp16 norms, ternary packing, and longest-prefix mixed bit-width selection; several divisibility assumptions are not validated.
The cact artifact is layer-major, 64-byte aligned, pretransposed, embeds tokenizer and KV numerics, and rejects unsupported head, lexicon, and sliding-window layouts.
Anonymous outbound telemetry is enabled by default with DO_NOT_TRACK and CI opt-outs; this default conflicts with FAK's explicit egress ownership.
Current source declares version 2.0.8 while tags reach v2.0.10; the release workflow tags HEAD after only a workspace-local version mutation and excludes slow tests.

Current main is Apache-2.0 after a 2026-08-17 MIT-to-Apache transition. The observed forge has 43 issues and 55 PRs, sparse review evidence, no GitHub Releases, and unresolved model-quality, multi-weight, and portability work.
